/**
 * The pack glyphs the blocks ask for. A preview page reads exactly these on
 * the server. It lives outside the client icon file so a server page can loop
 * over it.
 */

/** One glyph name a block asks for. */
export type BlockIconName = (typeof BLOCK_ICON_NAMES)[number];

/** The `<svg>` props of each icon a pack supplies, read on the server so no glyph data ships to the browser. */
export type BlockIconGlyphs = Partial<Record<BlockIconName, SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>>>;

@utility scroll-fade-effect-y.mask-image:
linear-gradient(to top, transparent, black 90%),
    linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0%, black 100%),
    linear-gradient(black, black)
